hints.source: Where material enters the line (Feed Station)
hints.textGen: LLM text generation (Text Shop); skill cards can be attached
hints.branch: Route to different pipes by condition
hints.map: Reshape or transform with a JSON template (Remap Bench)
hints.loop: Repeat the downstream steps for each array item
hints.parallel: Wait for every branch, then merge the output
hints.table: Filter, sort and aggregate CSV (Tally Bench)
hints.translate: Translate upstream text into the target language (Translate Room)
hints.ocr: Read text out of images (OCR Bench)
hints.convert: Pull images out of PDFs / convert image formats (Convert Bench)
hints.notify: Send to a group chat or email (Broadcast Station)
hints.sink: Where finished goods leave the line (Goods Store)
hints.human: Pause until a human signs off (Manual Post)
hints.generic: Multi Shop: pick any model provider, dispatched automatically by modality
hints.compliance: Platform rules and ad-law compliance check (Compliance Bench)
hints.fanout: Fan-out: copy one input into N variant lanes (different prompt / temperature / model)
hints.select: Select: reconverge variant lanes and pick TopK by LLM score / rule / human

missingModality: This node needs a {{modality}} model but none is configured; the node was added anyway — add one under Model Settings before dispatching.

sourceImages.label: Product images (upload or paste a URL — vision models can see them)
sourceImages.dropzone: Click to upload, or drag product images here

sourceFiles.label: Documents (PDF / DOCX / PPTX, read by {{node}})
sourceFiles.dropzone: Click to upload documents, or drag files here

inspector.conflict: This line was modified in another tab; your changes are unsaved.
inspector.name: Name
inspector.missingModel: No model of this type configured — configure one before running
inspector.structuredParseFailed: Structured product parse failed (invalid JSON) — cannot rich-render yet.

common.modelUnset: (Not configured — add a {{modality}} model in Settings first)
common.modelUnsetDefault: (Not configured — uses the default model at runtime)

source.prohibitedPh: Comma or newline separated, e.g. best, #1, national-grade
source.brandTermsPh: Comma or newline separated, e.g. slimming, breathable, versatile
source.notesPh: Other background, selling points, reference style, etc.

textGen.inputPolicyNoteAll: Default: concatenate all upstream outputs in order as the input.
textGen.inputPolicyNoteLast: Use only the most recent upstream node's output as input.
textGen.inputPolicyNoteTruncate: When over the max length, drop the front and keep the most recent tail (no model call, zero extra cost).
textGen.inputPolicyNoteSummary: When over the max length, call an LLM to rolling-summarize and keep key info (saves context, but costs a few extra tokens); passed through unchanged when under the threshold.
textGen.imageDirectives: Layout directives (image placement/ratio, applied next run)
textGen.imageDirectivesPh: e.g. hero image portrait 3:4 centered; scene cards in a 2-column grid; detail shots right-aligned

imageGen.prompt: Image prompt (blank = auto-generate from brand brief)
imageGen.promptPh: e.g. fresh Japanese-style hero image that highlights the product texture

videoGen.promptPh: e.g. product rotating in sunlight with a gradient background

audioGen.promptPh: TTS: text to read aloud; music: style description

gate.criterionPh: What must the output satisfy? Failures are sent back along the rework line.
gate.minScore: Quality score threshold (0–10, blank = no gate)
gate.minBrandCoverage: Brand term coverage threshold (0–100%, blank = no gate)

compliance.extraBannedPh: One word per line, or comma separated. Merged with the built-in Ad Law superlative list.
compliance.failOnViolation: Route to error edge on violation
compliance.hint: The compliance desk runs deterministic rule checks (Ad Law superlatives, length, hashtags) and emits a sanitized rewrite; chain it with the gate for wash-then-judge.

publish.title: Title (optional, defaults to the first line upstream)
publish.titlePh: Leave blank to use the first line upstream as the title
publish.hint: The publish desk assembles the upstream copy into a platform-ready package: split title/body, extract hashtags, and list image ratios for zero-formatting manual copy.

fanout.prompts: Prompts (one per line; count must equal variants)
fanout.angleBrief: Auto-angle brief (used when prompts are empty)
fanout.hint: Fan-out copies one input into N variant lanes; the downstream sub-graph runs independently per variant and reconverges at a Select desk.

select.hint: The Select desk waits for every variant lane to reach a terminal state, then keeps TopK by LLM score / rule / human. A failed lane only ends that lane; survivors still rank.

http.query: Query params (one key: value per line)
http.outputModeAuto: Auto (JSON response stored as json artifact)
http.outputModeFile: File (binary download for the file-parse node)
http.failOnError: Treat non-2xx responses as node failure
http.note: URL / headers / query / body support variable interpolation: ${upstreamNodeId.field}, e.g. ${source.price}.

code.note: The script receives JSON on stdin: {"inputs": {upstreamNodeId: value}}; stdout outputting a single JSON object/array becomes a json artifact, other text becomes a text artifact; a non-zero exit code or timeout is treated as node failure. Scripts can reference upstream variables: ${source.price}.

branch.rulesTitle: Branch rules (first match wins, in order)
branch.note: Example conditions: ${api.price} > 100 && ${api.stock} > 0. Supports == != > < >= <= && || ! and parentheses; with no match and no default branch, the message is dropped and downstream of that branch does not run.

map.iteratePh: e.g. data.items; blank maps a single object
map.note: The template is valid JSON with ${...} inside string values: ${item.name} references the current item, ${upstreamNodeId.field} references any upstream. Pure placeholders keep number/object types; with an iteration array, one output is produced per item and returned as an array.

loop.note: Runs the downstream subgraph (loop body) once per array item; the body can reference ${item.field}. After the loop, each round's output is aggregated into { "results": [...] } for downstream. Iterations are truncated past the max.

parallel.pickPh: e.g. data.text; blank takes the full output
parallel.note: Waits for all upstream branches then aggregates their output (array or object). Each branch already runs in parallel; this node provides an explicit structured join point.

table.note: Input: upstream CSV text (add a Parse step first), a JSON array, or { rows: [...] }. Output {rows, count, columns}; with output format = CSV, an extra CSV text is produced. An empty step list wraps the input into a table unchanged.

database.note: Queries output {rows, count, columns} and feed straight into a downstream Table node for filtering/sorting/aggregation; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE output {affectedRows, lastInsertId}. File paths resolve relative to the server working directory (packages/server). SQL syntax errors or parameter mismatches fail the node.

fileParse.note: Extracts text and embedded images (PDF / DOCX / PPTX) from the upstream file artifact. Text becomes a text artifact (directly consumable by agent nodes); images become image artifacts. Upstream can download documents via an HTTP node with output mode = file, or other nodes that produce files.

translate.targetPh: e.g. Simplified Chinese / English / 日本語
translate.note: Reads the upstream text artifact (falls back to JSON serialization when there is no text), translates it to the target language via an LLM, and outputs a text artifact. Chain with the file-parse node: extract document text first, then translate.

ocr.note: Reads the upstream image artifact, recognizes text with tesseract.js, and outputs a text artifact. Chain with the file-parse node: extract images from PDF / Word first, then OCR to text; default language is eng, choose chi_sim for Chinese.

convert.note: With target = PDF → images, reads the upstream file artifact and extracts each page's embedded images (one per page for scanned PDFs; chain with OCR); with PNG / JPEG, re-encodes upstream images to that format (batch supported, JPEG quality adjustable).

search.queryPh: Blank = use the upstream text artifact as the query
search.apiKeyPh: Fill here to take effect immediately, no restart
search.note: Runs a web search and outputs both a text (readable list) and json (structured) artifact; downstream agent nodes can read and summarize directly. Blank query uses the upstream text artifact (let an agent generate the query first); DuckDuckGo needs no key, other providers accept an API key in the node (encrypted before persisting), falling back to server env TAVILY_API_KEY / SERPAPI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY+GOOGLE_CX.

notify.messagePh: Blank = send the upstream text artifact as the message
notify.secretPh: SEC… (fill when the bot has signing enabled)
notify.subject: Email subject (optional)
notify.note: Sends a message to a Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bot or email; the send result is stored as an auditable json artifact. A blank message sends the upstream text artifact — the last mile of search → summarize → notify; email requires SMTP_HOST / SMTP_USER / SMTP_PASS env vars on the server.

vcs.prTitle: PR title (optional, defaults to node name)
vcs.commentBody: Comment body (optional, defaults to upstream text)
vcs.head: Source branch head
vcs.note: Performs version-control actions on GitHub / GitLab; API results are stored as a json artifact. create_pr / comment_issue with a blank body uses the upstream text artifact (let an agent draft the PR description first); a Token filled here takes effect immediately (encrypted before persisting), falling back to server env GITHUB_TOKEN / GITLAB_TOKEN (self-hosted GitLab can set an API base or GITLAB_API_URL).

human.promptPh: e.g. confirm this copy is ready to publish
human.note: The run pauses at this node and waits for human approval. Upstream text is shown to the approver: approve passes it through unchanged; edit continues with the edited content; reject fails the node (caught by an error edge, otherwise the line fails).

subprocess.note: This node calls another saved line (sub-flow) as a function: upstream text becomes the sub-flow's input, and all of its sink outputs are aggregated into this node's json artifact. Pauses inside the sub-flow (human approval / dangerous tools) bubble up to pause the whole line, resuming from the sub-flow checkpoint. maxDepth guards against circular calls.
